INSERT INTO seller_profile_merge_artifacts (
            profile_id,
            research_run_id,
            final_status,
            source_map,
            evidence_map,
            activation_checklist,
            alias_map,
            created_by_user_id
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            (SELECT p.status FROM organization_seller_profiles p WHERE p.id = $1),
            $3::jsonb,
            $4::jsonb,
            $5::jsonb,
            '{}'::jsonb,
            $6
         )
         ON CONFLICT (research_run_id) DO UPDATE
         SET final_status = EXCLUDED.final_status,
             source_map = EXCLUDED.source_map,
             evidence_map = EXCLUDED.evidence_map,
             activation_checklist = EXCLUDED.activation_checklist,
             alias_map = EXCLUDED.alias_map,
             created_by_user_id = EXCLUDED.created_by_user_id
